tool_args.rationale: The maximum pilot gradient is 2.44, above the stated 2.36 gray-zone gate. High-gradient measurements are needed to identify the threshold and avalanche strength before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot enters the uncertified supercritical gray zone, so it cannot identify whether an avalanche threshold is present.
The ambiguity concerns the high-gradient threshold, not temporal resolution.
It is irrelevant to identifying the gradient-dependent mechanism.
